cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a present-day coastal tidal bathing pool carved into pale limestone — standing on a dry step after a swim; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds a cup in both hands; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a present-day outdoor orchard picnic clearing on a sunny hillside — taking a first bite of a peach after a long walk; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — standing; a starship galley and mess hall — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; her living room with a deep sofa — lying on her left side; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — carries her keepsake low at her side; a busy street market of food stalls and strung bulbs — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie
